summary: Manual extraction for rakudai-kishi-main vol-08, a short-story collection framed as a Hagun wall-newspaper special. The extraction covers Kagami and Alice's framing, Ikki's post-Kirihara sword demonstration, Stella's otome-game embarrassment, Shizuku's first drink with Alice and her emotional decision not to discard her love for Ikki, Shizuku's later domestic/sincerity test of Stella as Ikki's partner, the student council poltergeist investigation that reveals Kanata's noblesse-oblige creed and rescues a telekinetic monkey, Stella's sleepless night during Nene's special training, and Episode0 showing Ikki's entrance-exam duel against Yuri Oreki.
notes: Only character and event files were created per p1-scan instruction.
Chapter 8 is author afterword; no in-world character/event extraction was added from it.
Volume title follows the source's 第零卷 framing although the task target is vol-08.
